@graph.name: Cascade vocabulary and standard queries
@graph.description: The ontology and shapes files a Cascade Bridge Adapter's output is read against, every term in the one namespace https://ns.cascadeprotocol.org/cascade#: clinical terms adapted from the-cascade-protocol/spec under CC BY 4.0, each naming the commit it was copied from with dct:source, and the terms first declared here under Apache-2.0. Beside them, the standard SPARQL queries over a pod written in those terms; each derivation and each lens carries the position it runs at. Under runtime/, the rules a runtime follows when it fills a pod, as Gherkin feature files with the examples that show each rule, the steps they are written in, and the scripted input the examples name. Under conformance/, the scenarios every runtime must pass: Alex Rivera's story, Priya Natarajan's and Martin Okafor's, each with its scripted input and its right answers. Under people/, the hand-written test people, each the one place their name, birth date and gender are written, with what each hospital holds of them.
